english_text: The Parliament 's Resolution is even worse than the Commission proposals . The EU is becoming more and more militarised . The spending of an additional one billion Euros on armament research would be yet a further step in this direction . In rejecting the Constitutional Treaty , the people of France and the Netherlands also rejected the EU militarisation envisaged in that Treaty . It is a scandal that the protagonists of this militarized EU are simply going ahead with their plans regardless . Instead of pretending to create jobs with huge spending on armaments , the EU should spend more on civil research programs - and not follow in the footsteps of the United States .
